qualification: Independent spatial audit of historical sampler and initial-state tails; no dynamical stability inference is drawn from spatial agreement.

derivation.note: Analytic identity is checked against independent two-dimensional density integration, not just marginal empirical CDFs.

scientificNotes: Hernquist and Miyamoto-Nagai spatial tails are untruncated; extreme radii are not discarded.
Number and mass fractions coincide within each original equal-mass component but not across components.

Per-particle potentials/virials in galaxyRealizations use the smooth analytic reference field, not a discrete softened N-body force. Half m Phi apportions continuum self energy; it is not a replacement for measured discrete conservation diagnostics.
Antipodal partners do not double the independent spatial sample size. Main generator COM recentering matters for odd component counts.
Global spatial moments can be dominated by heavy tails; quantile profiles and aperture-labelled measures are reported separately.

scopeLimits: Three deterministic pseudorandom seeds quantify sampling scatter; no exhaustive statistical proof is claimed.
The independent sampler draws are not antipodally duplicated. Full-galaxy tails and moments separately use the historical paired initializer.
No halo/disk potential or density parameter is fitted or renormalized in this audit.
Potential and virial contributions of extreme particles use the fixed analytic reference field. Full discrete softened self-energy requires a separate force-engine evaluation.
Infinite-tail model spatial second moments need not exist; sample maxima and RMS radii vary strongly with N and seed.
